Review 10x Designers?

Reviewers mainly praise 10x Designers as a warm, highly engaged design community that is especially helpful for people early in their design journey. They repeatedly highlight supportive members, strong peer connections, and detailed feedback, with some noting that members even create custom Figma files to help each other. Users also mention a steady flow of lessons, talks, live sessions, workshops, and resources, saying the mix of learning and community keeps them motivated. There is little critical feedback in the reviews provided, so sentiment is narrowly but consistently positive.

What a journey it has been! I'm so glad I found the community right when I first started venturing into design. Met so many great community members who I now call friends, friends who've been so supportive of my journey. I've found motivation during hard times in witnessing their journeys as well. And having a home for endless design lessons, talks, live sessions, feedbacks, and resources that I never would've been able to find myself is just an awesome perk on top of the community aspect. To think that it's not yet even been a year since this community started is mind-blowing. I'm so excited and all-in on what's to come next!
